raw_segments.text: Fourteen years before, he had murdered the widow of a landowner, a wealthy and handsome
young woman who had a house in our town.
He fell passionately in love with her, declared his feeling, and tried to persuade her to
But she had already given her heart to another man, an officer of noble birth and high rank
in the service, who was at that time away at the front, though she was expecting him
She refused his offer and begged him not to come and see her.
After he had ceased to visit her, he took advantage of his knowledge of the house to
enter at night through the garden by the roof, at great risk of discovery.
